legend: You are given two permutations$$$^{\text{∗}}$$$ and must compute the edit distance between them using only the following edits:
Given a length $$$n$$$ permutation, insert $$$n+1$$$ anywhere into the array, resulting in a permutation of length $$$n+1$$$.
Given a length $$$n$$$ permutation, delete $$$n$$$ from the array, resulting in a permutation of length $$$n-1$$$.

The edit distance between two permutations $$$p$$$ and $$$q$$$ is the minimum possible number of edits it takes to turn $$$p$$$ into $$$q$$$ or vice versa. It can be shown that, given the edits above, it does not matter which permutation you start with.

$$$^{\text{∗}}$$$A permutation of length $$$n$$$ is an array consisting of $$$n$$$ distinct integers from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$ in arbitrary order. For example, $$$[2,3,1,5,4]$$$ is a permutation, but $$$[1,2,2]$$$ is not a permutation ($$$2$$$ appears twice in the array), and $$$[1,3,4]$$$ is also not a permutation ($$$n=3$$$ but there is $$$4$$$ in the array).
input: Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$). The description of the test cases follows.
The first line of each test case contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$m$$$ ($$$1\leq n,\,m\leq 2\cdot10^5$$$) — the lengths of the permutations.
The second line of each test case contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$p_1,\,p_2,\,\ldots,\,p_n$$$ ($$$1\leq p_i\leq n$$$) — the permutation $$$p$$$.
The last line of each test case contains $$$m$$$ integers $$$q_1,\,q_2,\,\ldots,\,q_m$$$ ($$$1\leq q_i\leq m$$$) — the permutation $$$q$$$.
It is guaranteed that the sum of $$$\max(n,\,m)$$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$.
output: For each test case, output a single integer — the minimum number of valid edits to transform $$$p$$$ into $$$q$$$.
note: In the first test case, inserting 5 into $$$p$$$ in the second position will result in $$$q$$$.

In the second test case, first delete $$$3$$$ and $$$2$$$ from the end of $$$p$$$. Then insert $$$2$$$ into the beginning, and after that insert $$$3$$$ into the beginning as well. This will result in $$$q$$$, and it can be shown that this is a minimal solution.
In the third test case, the permutations are already equal.

legend.ai: 给定两个排列$$$^{\text{∗}}$$$，你需要仅使用以下编辑操作计算它们之间的编辑距离：
给定一个长度为 $$$n$$$ 的排列，将 $$$n+1$$$ 插入数组中的任意位置，得到一个长度为 $$$n+1$$$ 的排列。
给定一个长度为 $$$n$$$ 的排列，从数组中删除 $$$n$$$，得到一个长度为 $$$n-1$$$ 的排列。
两个排列 $$$p$$$ 和 $$$q$$$ 之间的编辑距离，是将 $$$p$$$ 变为 $$$q$$$ 或反之所需的最少编辑次数。可以证明，在给定上述编辑操作的情况下，从哪个排列开始并不影响结果。

input.ai: 每个测试包含多组测试用例。第一行包含测试用例的数量 $$$t$$$($$$1 \le t \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$)。接下来是各测试用例的描述。
每个测试用例的第一行包含两个整数 $$$n$$$ 和 $$$m$$$($$$1\leq n,\,m\leq 2\cdot10^5$$$)——两个排列的长度。
每个测试用例的第二行包含 $$$n$$$ 个整数 $$$p_1,\,p_2,\,\ldots,\,p_n$$$ ($$$1\leq p_i\leq n$$$)，即排列 $$$p$$$。
每个测试用例的最后一行包含 $$$m$$$ 个整数 $$$q_1,\,q_2,\,\ldots,\,q_m$$$($$$1\leq q_i\leq m$$$)——排列 $$$q$$$。
保证所有测试用例的 $$$\max(n,\,m)$$$ 之和不超过 $$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$。

output.ai: 对于每组测试用例，输出一个整数——将 $$$p$$$ 变为 $$$q$$$ 所需的最少有效编辑次数。

note.ai: 在第一个测试用例中，将 5 插入到 $$$p$$$ 的第二个位置后，结果为 $$$q$$$。
在第二个测试用例中，首先从 $$$p$$$ 的末尾删除 $$$3$$$ 和 $$$2$$$。然后在开头插入 $$$2$$$，之后再在开头插入 $$$3$$$。最终得到 $$$q$$$，可以证明这是一个最优解。
在第三个测试用例中，两个排列已经相等。
